sloka: युवाम् असंख्येय गुणौ भ्रातरौ मिथिलेश्वरौ ।ऋषयो राज संघाः च भवद्भ्याम् अभिपूजिताः ॥१-७२-१८॥
transliteration: yuvām asaṁkhyeya guṇau bhrātarau mithileśvarau ।ṛṣayo rāja saṁghāḥ ca bhavadbhyām abhipūjitāḥ ॥1-72-18॥

translations.english: "You both brothers are lords of Mithila. You possess countless virtues. You pay regards to many rishis and hosts of kings".
